drivingQuestion: Why may the basket with the stone be moved rather than shaking out the stone?
outcomeNote: the mishna is set in a broken basket the stone plugs

segments.he: וְלִינַעֲרִינְהוּ נַעוֹרֵי! אָמַר רַב חִיָּיא בַּר אָשֵׁי אָמַר רָבָא: הָכָא בְּכַלְכַּלָּה פְּחוּתָה עָסְקִינַן, דְּאֶבֶן גּוּפָהּ נַעֲשֵׂית דּוֹפֶן לַכַּלְכַּלָּה.
segments.en: The Gemara asks a question: «And let him shake them» until the stone is on one side of the basket, enabling him to throw the stone out of the basket. «Rav Hiyya bar Ashi said» that «Rava said: Here, we are dealing with a broken basket» with a hole, in which the «stone serves as a side of the basket» by sealing the hole. Therefore, he cannot throw it out of the basket.
